systems.tiers: Anambra State; deployment began with its 21 local governments (budget, payroll verification against NIN and BVN, vendors and procurement) and is to extend to all state ministries

note: A June 2025 report on a state-built AI tool checking the payroll and spending of Anambra's 21 local governments; it says government processes there remain largely manual and paper-based, and states nothing about a connection at any local government office or staff working online from one.
